title: Death's Final Chapter
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji finally glimpsed that eye overlooking the fate of all living beings, he realized he was merely the most insignificant piece on the chessboard—and the chess player's malice had never ceased.

text.content: The seventh page of the Tianji Record slowly manifested beneath his fingertips, like an eye that had slumbered for ten thousand years being forcibly awakened. Ink-black characters condensed from the void, bringing with them a suffocating pressure that enveloped Chen Ji entirely. It was a gaze beyond human power, as if something was casting a glance at him from the depths of the river of destiny.

Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value plummeted in this moment—sixty, fifty, thirty points. The excruciating pain from his fingertips was like ten thousand ants gnawing at his heart. Each loss felt like tearing away something he was born with. His face turned as pale as paper, veins bulging at his temples, yet he clenched his teeth tightly, refusing to let out a single sound. The seventh page, he must see the seventh page!

dialogue.content: (Watching the slowly manifesting characters on the seventh page, voice hoarse) "Chapter Seven Hundred... Not the Final Chapter... The Wheel of Fate Has Other Arrangements..."

text.content: The complete prophecy finally manifested. Yet in this instant, Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—on the edge of those characters, there was an extremely subtle crack, as if torn apart by supreme power and then resealed. He reached out, and when his fingertips touched that fissure, an extremely cold malice surged directly into his mind through his consciousness.

This was not natural erosion of time, but deliberate tampering. Someone—or something—had erased the original content before he could see this prophecy, replacing it with 'The Wheel of Fate Has Other Arrangements.' Chen Ji's heart sank to the depths. His mind raced: Who possessed such ability? Who could alter the records of the Tianji Record?

dialogue.content: (Murmuring softly, voice carrying a slight tremor) "Chapter Seven Hundred Not the Final Chapter... So that's how it is... I thought I was seeing my death, but in reality, it's merely... a delayed calamity?"

text.content: Just then, from the depths of the seventh page of the Tianji Record, a blurry image slowly emerged. It was an eye—or rather, an overlap of countless eyes. Within each pupil was reflected a face, and those faces were unmistakably the dying features of prophecy-seers throughout history! Chen Ji's breath stopped completely in this moment.

dialogue.content: (A genderless, ice-cold voice rang out from the void) "Finally... A mere ant that can perceive my existence."

text.content: The voice did not come from his ears, but exploded directly within the depths of his soul, carrying irresistible authority. Chen Ji's Mental Sea violently trembled. He saw—in the depths of those countless eyes, a consciousness so massive it defied description lay sleeping. And he was merely a chess piece that consciousness had casually picked up during its endless years.

Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. His Tianji Record, his prophecy abilities, his meticulously laid plans—all were merely part of the chess game this being had arranged. He wanted to resist, but the excruciating pain in his Mental Sea made thinking nearly impossible. The sharp pain in his fingertips struck again; his Heavenly Fate Value had already reached zero!

choice.prompt: Faced with this existence beyond comprehension, Chen Ji had to make a choice—temporarily submit to this enormous conspiracy, or launch a feeble resistance with his broken body?

choices.description: First preserve his life, wait to investigate the true purpose of this 'Eye of Heavenly Way,' secretly seek its weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily Acknowledge Being a Chess Piece
choices.risk_hint: If Discovered by the Eye of Heavenly Way, Consequences Would Be Unthinkable

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the turbulent waves in his heart, slowly lowering his head, bowing to the eye in the void with an almost reverent posture. His voice was terrifyingly steady: 'The junior... accepts the command.' As those three words squeezed through his teeth, each syllable felt like carving a piece of flesh from his heart.

choices.description: Since he had already been discovered, he might as well take this opportunity to probe the purpose of this 'Eye of Heavenly Way,' perhaps capturing a flaw in its words.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal That He Is Not an Ignorant Ant
choices.visible_reward: May Gain More Intelligence About the Eye of Heavenly Way
choices.risk_hint: Draw the Eye of Heavenly Way's Attention, May Bring Greater Calamity

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to maintain the last shred of clarity, struggling to speak beneath that pressure: 'Senior... since you have already chosen the junior, why tamper with the prophecy and toy with me?' His voice trembled, yet hidden within was a blade of sharpness—this was a probe, and also his final defiance.

choices.description: No direct confrontation, only deeply branding everything seen into the mind, laying the groundwork for future counterattacks.
choices.visible_cost: Need to suppress the intense rage within
choices.visible_reward: Gained crucial intelligence: the existence of the Heavenly Eye and the fact that prophecies have been tampered with
choices.risk_hint: If the pent-up rage within loses control, it may lead to misjudgment

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent, his bloodshot eyes fixedly staring at that massive eye in the void. He muttered in his heart: 'I remember... one day, I will make you pay for today's mockery.' It was a hatred etched into the marrow, burning yet cold.

Just then, the light from the seventh page of the Tianji Record suddenly dimmed, and that eye overlooking all living beings slowly closed. The illusory form condensed from Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul appeared beside Chen Ji, his face showing unprecedented solemnity for the first time.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice low and hoarse) 'You've finally seen it... child, this path is much longer and far more dangerous than you imagine.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, his entire attention captured by the crack along the edge of the seventh page. The traces of tampering were so obvious, indicating that the Tianji Record itself was not completely controlled by the Heavenly Eye—if it were, why would it bother with this? This meant there was some unspoken struggle between the Tianji Record and the Heavenly Eye.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng seemed to know more truth, but his revelations always stopped at the key points. Should Chen Ji continue to press for answers?

choices.description: Things have come to this, there is no way back, must ask Mo Xiansheng clearly what this 'Heavenly Eye' really is.
choices.visible_cost: May anger Mo Xiansheng, causing him to withdraw some assistance
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information about the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may still be holding back, pressing may backfire

dialogue.content: (Voice hoarse yet firm) 'Master, you know what this 'Heavenly Eye' is, don't you? From the very beginning, you've been evading this question!'

choices.description: He understood Mo Xiansheng's temperament well—pressing too hard would only make him more tight-lipped. Better to digest today's revelations alone first, and ask again when the time was right.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily unable to obtain more information
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the current relationship with Mo Xiansheng, preserving space for future communication
choices.risk_hint: May miss the window period for obtaining crucial intelligence

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully swallowing all his questions. He slightly bowed to Mo Xiansheng: 'Master, the disciple understands.' Beneath that calm tone was an increasingly cold heart. He knew, some answers cannot be rushed.

Mo Xiansheng gazed at Chen Ji, a complex light flickering in those eyes formed from remnant souls. He seemed to want to say something, but finally just sighed: 'Child, remember, the Tianji Record chose you for a reason. As for that 'Heavenly Eye'... now that you know of its existence, you have already gone further than any prophet before.'

Chen Ji nodded silently. The weakness of Heavenly Fate Value returning to zero surged over him like a tide, yet the hatred burning in his heart was more intense than ever. Death prophecy? Delayed tribulation? The dark hand manipulating fate? He coldly smiled in his heart: 'Since the chessboard has revealed itself, let me see what this chess player is truly capable of.'
The seventh page of the Tianji Record slowly closed, that chilling eye completely disappearing into the void. But Chen Ji knew it was only temporary

choice.prompt: Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate value is nearly depleted; he must decide his next move.

choices.text: Immediately seek a method to restore the Heavenly Fate value
choices.description: Su Qingyao's 'Shared Destiny' skill might help restore his Heavenly Fate value; he must contact her as soon as possible.
choices.visible_cost: Need to expose his true situation to Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: May unlock the 'Shared Destiny' buff, significantly reducing subsequent consumption
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might investigate his secrets more deeply as a result

text.content: Chen Ji retrieved a communication jade slip from his chest, hesitated briefly, then activated it. A moment later, Su Qingyao's cold voice came through: 'Chen Ji? Late-night message—what's the matter?' His hand holding the jade slip trembled slightly, yet he still spoke: 'Senior Su... I need to see you.'

choices.text: Process it alone and plan the next move
choices.description: Tonight's events are too horrifying; one must sort through them alone, plan the next layout, and not let anyone get dragged into this murky mess.
choices.visible_cost: The body will bear a tremendous burden
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information superiority, avoid exposing more weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: If not restored in time, crucial opportunities might be missed

text.content: Chen Ji closed the communication jade slip and sat alone in the darkness. His fingertips still ached faintly—that was the price of his Heavenly Fate drain. He closed his eyes, yet his mind remained exceptionally clear: the Heavenly Eye, the altered prophecy, the postponed calamity... all the clues gradually formed connections in the darkness. 'Very well,' he murmured, 'since you want me dead, I shall survive instead, dragging each of you into the abyss.'

Night wind slipped through the window cracks, carrying biting cold. Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze piercing through layers of darkness toward the invisible depths of the heavens. Something there was watching him—the most terrifying existence he had ever encountered—yet the corners of his mouth now curved into a cold, sharp arc.

He, Chen Ji, has never feared death. Death prophecies or the Heavenly Eye—these are merely stepping stones on his path to ascension. True strength lies not in how long one lives, but in whether one can seize fate by the throat in the face of despair. Since this chess game has been laid bare before the world, let all under heaven witness how atrash overturns the entire board!
